failure_modes.description: JSON validation fail (any JSON file in run_dir)
failure_modes.rollback_action: Fix JSON syntax; revalidate with python -m json.tool
failure_modes.evidence_to_preserve: Save invalid JSON + error message to raw-logs/json-errors.txt

failure_modes.rollback_action: Recount states; fix state_count declaration; regenerate JSON

failure_modes.description: Missing evidence input (investigation bundle not found)
failure_modes.rollback_action: Record missing path; continue with other taskcards if evidence is non-blocking

failure_modes.description: Stale evidence (investigation findings may be outdated)
failure_modes.rollback_action: Mark finding 'STALE_EVIDENCE' in evidence-import-review.md; proceed with best available

failure_modes.description: Dirty working tree with unexpected state
failure_modes.rollback_action: git status output; record in raw-logs/git-status.txt; do not clean

failure_modes.description: Plan contradiction found late in sprint
failure_modes.rollback_action: Apply minimal repair; update required-plan-repairs.md; rerun validator
Revise prompt; remove unsafe instruction; re-review with adversarial check
failure_modes.evidence_to_preserve: Save unsafe version to raw-logs/unsafe-prompt-draft.txt (for reference only)
